interfaces.contract: Publish one immutable checksummed Release asset, validate every allowed redirect hop and final host, verify asset availability, then update stable-manifest.json last

Persist canonical retrieval_policy JSON in the existing bundle_meta key/value table without changing INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION. Required fields are enabled_sources; rrf_k; lexical_weight; vector_weight; candidate_count_per_channel; final_context_records; max_records_per_repository; and source_weights for owner_assertions, repository_metadata, documentation, and source_code. ReadOnlyIndex.open must require and strictly validate this metadata. Add frozen internal dataclasses RetrievalFilters(repository_slug: str|None = None, language: str|None = None, evidence_class: str|None = None, source_type: str|None = None) and PackedContext(text: str, evidence_ids: tuple[str,...], token_count: int). Extend hybrid_candidates with filters: RetrievalFilters|None = None; existing lexical_limit/vector_limit/final_limit become optional overrides capped by configured candidate_count_per_channel/final_context_records. Apply RRF with configured k/channel weights, filter exact validated metadata, map OWNER_ASSERTION to owner_assertions and otherwise use the indexed source_type category, multiply by configured source weights, sort by descending adjusted score then evidence ID, deduplicate intersecting ranges at the same repository/commit/path, apply max_records_per_repository unless filters.repository_slug is set, then apply the final limit. Define pack_context(self, evidence_ids: Sequence[str], *, max_context_tokens: int, token_counter: Callable[[str], int]) -> PackedContext. It loads every ranked ID fail-closed, assigns request-local S1... IDs, renders each record as a clearly delimited UNTRUSTED DATA block containing persistent ID, class, repository, commit, path and lines, adds whole records in rank order, and stops before the first record that would make token_counter(combined_text) exceed the positive budget. Reject boolean/nonpositive budgets and boolean/negative/non-integer counter results. Missing evidence raises safe IndexReadError('evidence_not_found'). This is an internal bundle metadata/reader contract, not a public API or database schema-version change.

Keep bounded get(url, headers) only for the small stable-manifest JSON. Add frozen internal DownloadResult(status: int, headers: Mapping[str, str], size_bytes: int, sha256: str) and BundleTransport.download_to(url: str, *, headers: Mapping[str, str], destination: Path, max_bytes: int) -> DownloadResult. download_to must validate the initial URL, every redirect hop, and the final host; stream fixed 64 KiB chunks directly to an exclusively created destination; enforce the positive non-boolean byte limit while streaming; and compute SHA-256 while writing. It must remove the partial destination on non-success status, redirect/network/size/filesystem failure, or any other exception. BundleUpdater compares returned status, size, and digest to the stable manifest before archive verification. Fixture transports stream deterministic bytes rather than returning a large response body. If verified candidate bundle_id differs from the stable manifest, BundleUpdater closes the candidate and removes candidate.directory. This is an internal transport/lifecycle contract and adds no public API, dependency, environment variable, or schema change.

consumers: GATE-BENCHMARK and Main Phase 2 acceptance review
interfaces.contract: The deterministic token-hash fixture provider must publish its actual fixture-only adapter/model identity and must never claim multilingual-e5 or any production adapter identity. The report separates harness_thresholds_met from formal_acceptance and sets passed=false whenever provider_is_production is false, oracle_isolation is not enforced, or the declared 4-core/8-GB reference-host provenance is not verified. Paired-language equivalence requires both the en and zh-TW member to hit acceptable expected evidence; incidental overlap between wrong retrieved paths does not pass. Record untimed warm-up rounds, measured rounds, timing sample count, question/pair counts, indexed repository/source/evidence counts, actual Python/NumPy/platform/machine/logical-CPU provenance, threshold values, repeatability, and explicit formal blockers. Validate nonempty uniquely identified one-en/one-zh-TW pairs and reject undersized evaluation inputs rather than emitting optimistic metrics. This is an evaluation evidence contract and does not alter production embedding/configuration schemas or approved thresholds.

consumers: immutable archive verifier and GitHub publication
interfaces.contract: Keep the existing build_bundle signature, bundle schema, deterministic member order/metadata, and public_files bytes contract. Validate index.sqlite as a nonempty file and public_files as the exact remaining required payload set. Compute index size/digest with stat and fixed 64 KiB file hashing, stream index.sqlite directly into tarfile.addfile from a binary file handle, and use fixed-size file hashing for the completed outer archive; never call read_bytes on the index or completed archive. Small bounded manifest, checksum, profile, character, and card bytes may remain in memory. Every archive write/hash/replace failure removes only the generated temporary output and raises the existing safe BundleError boundary. Add tests proving production bundle bytes remain accepted and monkeypatched index/archive read_bytes calls cannot occur. This is an internal resource implementation contract and changes no manifest, archive layout, public API, dependency, environment variable, or schema version.
